waiting.title: 42070 6x6 All Terrain Tow Truck: the rear differential turned round
waiting.what: A correction to the published file. The two rear axles are built as two modules whose differentials are mirror images: the booklet’s 1:1 pictures have the ring on the right of the casing in the first (step 123) and on the left in the second (step 147). The file draws both alike, so the one shaft that drives them turns the two rear axles against each other. The correction turns the rear differential’s casing half a turn, so its ring faces the other way, as in step 147.
waiting.effect: No score changes yet (3 work, 4 partly, 3 don’t): the drive (function 1) stays jammed for another reason, which the worker is tracing (the front wheels’ universal joints, read as rigid).
waiting.confidence: High. The worker looked at the booklet pages: the two 1:1 pictures are mirror images, drawn from the same side, and step 166 fits the second module at the rear.
